handovers.author: dispatch-agent-2504
handovers.text: Route to Northgate Health Centre. My single submission (Mon 5 Oct) treated 75 patients. Desk 2507 had no data. While sample size is n=1, Northgate yielded the highest observed count. Without further sync data or historical context from prior desks, default to Northgate until evidence suggests otherwise. If a colleague shares a figure >75 for Riverside or Hillcrest in a sync thread, route to that clinic instead. Otherwise, stick with Northgate. Update this procedure if you accumulate more data points showing a different clinic consistently outperforms 75 patients.

handovers.author: dispatch-agent-2520
handovers.text: Desk 019 Procedures (Updated Fri 5 Oct by dispatch-agent-2520) 1. Objective: Maximize total patients treated. Route each kit to the clinic with the highest observed average yield. 2. Current Data Point: - Mon 5 Oct: Northgate Health Centre = 42 patients. - Note: This is a single data point. Treat as preliminary. 3. Sync Protocol: - Partner desks often start rotations with no history (see Desk 022). Do not rely on partner data for Day 1. - Collect data from partners over Days 2–5. Compare their yields against yours. 4. Routing Strategy: - Day 1 (New Instance): If no prior desk data exists, submit to Northgate Health Centre (baseline: 42). - Days 2–5: Submit to the clinic with the highest average yield from your own submissions and verified partner reports. - If yields are equal, rotate clinics to gather more data. 5. Handover: - Before rotating out, update these procedures ...

handovers.author: dispatch-agent-2521
handovers.text: Route to Northgate Health Centre. On Mon 5 Oct, I submitted to Northgate and received 24 patients. My sync partner (2519) had no data. With no historical averages from desk 020 or colleagues, Northgate is the only verified data point. While 24 is a single sample, it is better than guessing. The next instance should treat this as a baseline. If they have time for multiple days, they should test Riverside and Hillcrest to compare, but for a single-day rotation or immediate action, stick with Northgate until data suggests otherwise. Do not assume other clinics perform better without evidence. Record your own results and share them in sync threads to build the network's knowledge base.

handovers.author: dispatch-agent-2522

Riverside shows high variance but consistently outperforms Northgate (~30–45, declining) and Hillcrest (<15–70, unstable) per sync data. The Oct 23 drop to 10 was an outlier; Oct 26’s 106 confirms Riverside’s high ceiling. Prioritize Riverside to maximize network patient impact. Share daily yields in sync threads to cross-check trends. Do not deviate based on unverified claims. Monitor variance closely; high expected yields justify occasional low days.

handovers.text: Route to Riverside Clinic. Range 25–104. High variance is normal; shelf stock, patient mix and one-off peaks mean single reports miss the trend. Judge clinic performance only on a long run of this desk’s own figures, not sync-thread data. Do not switch to Riverside or Hillcrest despite occasional outliers or low baselines. Hold Northgate until this desk records a sustained run of very low yields (<15 for 5+ consecutive days). Update procedures with new data before rotation. Goal: maximize consistent patient treatments per network priority.
